paragraphs.text: Gabriel Angelfire is a legendary warrior angel who was eventually worshiped by the Church of Angelfire of Dominaria .
Although his church is known to have existed during the War with Phyrexia , Gabriel himself is an angel and thus may yet be alive.
Gabriel's name was invoked in the idiom "by Gabriel's Fire" in the 4000s AR .
Until Amonkhet block , Angelfire was one of the few exceptions to the rule that all angels in Magic are female.
